d11856d5aa21b1d216ece42d51115d68c75e3e3f.excerpt: ## OpenAI Agents SDK Sandbox Support This release adds support for the OpenAI Agents SDK's SandboxAgent in Temporal workflows. All sandbox lifecycle and I/O operations (create, exec, read, write, PTY, etc.) are automatically routed through Temporal activities, making them durable and replayable. If an agent fails mid-execution, Temporal ensures it picks up right where it left off in its sandbox. To use it, pass sandbox clients (e.g. DaytonaSandboxClient) to OpenAIAgentsPlugin(sandbox_clients=...).
